statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-2236: libgcrypt's RSA decryption has a timing side channel that a remote attacker who can submit many ciphertexts may use for a Bleichenbacher-style (Marvin) attack to decrypt RSA ciphertexts, in every RSA padding mode (https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2024-2236, https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2245218). Red Hat fixed it in its own packages with downstream patches (RHSA-2024:9404); the libgcrypt release notes through 1.12.3 record no fix, and Debian lists trixie's 1.11.0-7+deb13u1 as vulnerable and the issue as unfixed in unstable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2024-2236. The DHI Debian repository publishes libgcrypt20 for Debian 13 as a single rebuild of Debian's 1.11.0-7+deb13u1 (amd64 and arm64), whose shipped changelog adds no change beyond the rebuild. It carries no fix for this issue, so every published build is affected.
